reports.title: Epstein's $100 Million-Plus Estate At Stake | New Mexico AG Demands Justice For Survivors | VERTEX
reports.description:
New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez has filed a federal civil lawsuit against Jeffrey Epstein's longtime attorney Darren Indyke and accountant Richard Kahn, accusing them of facilitating and concealing his sex trafficking operation, including activities at Zorro Ranch. The lawsuit seeks to block the two estate executors from receiving payments from Epstein's estate, valued at more than $100 million, and secure compensation for survivors. Torrez said Epstein's remaining assets should benefit survivors rather than individuals accused of enabling his crimes. Indyke and Kahn have denied knowledge of or involvement in Epstein's trafficking operation.
